lines.en: I mean, there are libraries, it's just that I, um, I've never worked at one.
You know what's really good here?
What do you say, shall I just order three?
It was a joke, I made a joke.
Yeah, actually, Daddy, Ross is allergic to lobster.
What kind of person is allergic to lobster?
I guess the kind of person that works in the library.
What, you're the only one around here who can make a joke?
Um, I have, I have a problem.
I, I tip way too much.
We really, really have to do something.
Oh, Daddy, no, you didn't mean anything by that.
Nothing I do means anything, really.
I pay $200 for dinner, you put down $20,
and you come out looking like Mr. Big Shot.
You really want to be Mr. Big Shot?
You pay the whole bill, Mr. Big Shot, all right?
Rachel, one brunch is not going to solve anything.
You've got to face it, okay?
We're never going to get along.
Okay, well, you are just going to have to, okay?
Because I've already got a mother and a father
who cannot stay in the same room together, okay?
I don't want to have to have a separate room for you, too.
Dr. Bobby happens to be an excellent doctor.
And, um, excuse me, he helps me.
What do you need help for?
I got one leg shorter than the other.
My right leg is two inches shorter.
So what do you let her go to a chiropractor for?
She doesn't listen to me about, uh,
Well, what if somebody steals something?
How are you going to run after them
with one leg shorter than the other?
Hey, would you, uh, would you like some juice?
Wow, this is going so well.
Yeah, honey, I'm standing right there.
Why don't you just tell them about them all?
